tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background, the sidebar and the top bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, forms, and everything that floats: menus, popovers, dialogs and toasts.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, segmented controls, hover on rows, code.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and checkboxes (3:1 on surface and ground).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, sunken and honey-soft.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons on ground, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders and timestamps on ground, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: The accent: the primary button, selection, the current navigation item, the leader. A fill only in the light theme (1.9:1 on surface).

tokens.name: honey-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of honey fills.

tokens.name: on-honey
tokens.usage: Text and icons on honey and honey-strong.

tokens.name: honey-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows and the current navigation item. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: honey-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent text on surface and ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring (3:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy, valid, done: the status dot and its word on surface and ok-soft; the on state of switches.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success banners.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded, expiring, needs attention: dot and word on surface and warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Down, failed, destructive: dot, error text and the danger button. Always with a word.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on critical fills.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information, followers, agent actions in the audit log.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info banners.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs.

families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.text: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.data: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Setup and large empty states only.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: The page title, once per view.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Sub-sections, field groups, project names on cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Requests to shop.example.com are split between two target groups.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Navigation groups and labels above titles. Sentence case, ink-3.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Hostnames, IPs, ports, IDs, commands. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The value of a stat, in the display face with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, dot to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to field, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between fields; card padding under 640px.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; between field groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Around empty states and page headers.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top on setup screens.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tags, code, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus, toasts, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, switches, counts.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on ground.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts and dialogs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Controls in tables and filter bars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Touch layouts and the final action of setup.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the sidebar at 1024px and wider.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Width of the collapsed sidebar (icons only).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of lists and dashboards.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of single-column forms.
